handoff_findings.description: The [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ key-grammar `case` runs BEFORE the alias block overwrites `_key` with an existing overrides.json record key, and the aliased key is never re-checked. Driven end-to-end: an overrides record keyed `testcat!!!key` whose token set matched was emitted verbatim on stdout. The AC's 'constrains EVERY filing key it emits' is false for the aliased path, and lib/meta-issue.sh will reject such a key downstream.

The alias signature is computed with `tokset` over the FULL key (category prefix + subslug), and `unique` collapses a subslug token the category already contributes. Probed live: with category `tooling-gap`, a new key `tooling-gap-gap-slow` signature-collides with existing `tooling-gap-slow` — two different sub-patterns falsely aliased onto one record. This falsifies the source comment's stated universal ('two strings differing by ANY token get distinct signatures') and the AC's 'equal SUBSLUG token sets' semantics; the AC and the code disagree about what is tokenized.

The >3-findings AC requires the run to record a line naming the pattern and the number dropped. The truncation notice is written to stderr ONLY, with no `--dropped-file` channel (contrast `--withheld-file`, which exists precisely so cap withholds can be named in the report). Step 8c captures stdout only, so the drop count never reaches skip_records/blockers/withheld and never renders. AC undischarged.

Claim-side only, no code defect: the checklist alleged the rc captures might be vacuous; every capture follows a BARE (non-`local`) command-substitution assignment, so `$?` is correct. Recorded as a FAIL only because property_proven is false, which blocks wording-only normalization.

Claim-side only, no code defect: both alleged self-contradictions were disproved — the 'exactly one JSON object' sentence is about stdout structure, not element count, and the same diff adds a sentence scoping the 'One proposed change' Hard rule per finding.

PASS-verdict items whose verifiers nonetheless recorded inaccuracy_scope=source_authored_text: (VC-9) the module labels the alias comparison a 'token multiset' when `unique` makes it a set; (VC-52) Step 8a's three `<<< "$pattern"` herestrings contradict the same paragraph's unconditional no-herestring prohibition over the enriched object; (VC-55) the findings-array branch's `source` is unguarded, so a not-sourced helper is misattributed by the else arm to select-findings' own cap-owner arm; (VC-56) the 'sole owner ... every cap decision' universal is false because the legacy title/body branch derives its own cap verdict.
